data.name: Curtice
data.long_meaning: Curtice is a name derived from the Roman name Curtis, meaning 'courageous'. In the Bible, there is a figure named Curtis (or Quirinius) mentioned in Luke 3:1, who was a governor of Syria during the time of Jesus' birth. Therefore, the name Curtice carries both ancient Roman and biblical significance.
